title: Lead Electronic Hardware Design Engineer
description:
Lead Electronic Hardware Design Engineer 

 About the Role: 
 We are looking for a Lead Electronic Hardware Design Engineer to own the architecture and development of our product portfolio: EV chargers (EVSE), ticket validators, edge compute platforms and payment terminals. You will take hardware from concept to certified, production-ready product, work closely with firmware, mechanical and compliance teams, and mentor junior engineers. 
 EVSE | Ticket Validator | Edge Compute | Payment Hardware 
 Roles and Responsibilities Product Innovation: Conceptualize, research and design hardware for EVSE (AC and DC fast charging), ticket validators, edge compute devices and payment terminals. Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers, run design reviews, and set standards for design, documentation and testing. EVSE and Power Electronics: Design control, metering, protection and communication boards, including pilot/CCS/CHAdeMO interfaces, isolation, contactor control and insulation monitoring. Edge Compute and Connectivity: Design SoM/SoC-based boards with high-speed interfaces (DDR, USB, SATA, Ethernet, PCIe, MIPI), LTE/Wi-Fi/BLE/NFC/GNSS modules and low-noise analog front ends. Payment and Validator Hardware: Integrate card readers (contact, contactless, magstripe), secure elements, tamper-detection circuits, displays and barcode/QR/NFC readers, with secure interfaces to the host processor. Execution: Own schematic capture, PCB layout (high-speed, mixed-signal, power, RF), board bring-up, debugging, DFM/DFT and handover to manufacturing. Thermal Design and Validation: Design for thermal efficiency from the start. Validate real board behavior using thermal imaging, sensor logging and chamber/soak testing. Find hotspots and root causes, and fix them through layout, components, copper/vias, heatsinking, airflow, enclosure changes and derating. Drive thermal sign-off against component limits and certification temperature-rise requirements. Certification Ownership: Define the compliance plan for each product type and design for it from day one. Work with labs and ODMs through pre-compliance, testing, failure analysis and final approval. Documentation: Maintain schematics, BOMs, design calculations, test and thermal reports, risk files and certification dossiers. Desired Candidate Profile Education: B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent. Experience: Minimum 7 years of hands-on hardware design, including at least 2 shipped, certified products in the EV charging, payment or embedded/edge domain. Technical Foundation: Strong command of analog, digital, power and microcontroller/microprocessor design, and of high-speed and mixed-signal PCB layout. Thermal Expertise: Proven ability to measure, diagnose and fix thermal problems on high-power or enclosed products, and to deliver verified fixes. Tools: Altium, OrCAD, Cadence, KiCad or equivalent; signal-integrity and thermal simulation tools (Icepak, Flotherm or equivalent). Personal Attributes: Problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and comfort working with external labs, ODMs and vendors. Certification Experience Hands-on experience in at least two of the areas below is required; more is preferred. Product 
 Certifications and Standards 
 Thermal Requirements EVSE (AC/DC) 
 UL 2594, UL 2202, UL 2231, IEC 61851-1/-23, IEC 62196, CE/FCC, BIS/AIS-138, IS 17017, OCPP and ISO 15118 conformance, metering regulations 
 Temperature-rise testing, connector/cable temperature limits, over-temperature protection Ticket Validator 
 FCC/CE/BIS EMC and radio, NFC (ISO 14443, EMVCo L1 contactless), transit standards, GMS (via ODM) if Android-based, IP/IK ratings 
 Operating temperature range, sunload, touchable surface limits Edge Compute 
 FCC/CE/BIS EMC, IEC 62368-1, PTCRB/GCF, WPC/TEC, ESD/surge, vibration 
 Thermal throttling behavior, sustained full-load testing Payment Terminal 
 EMVCo L1 (contact and contactless), PCI PTS POI, PCI PIN, tamper resistance, secure boot and key injection, card-brand approvals 
 Operating temperature range, touchable surface limits Key Skills Design: Digital/analog/power PCB design, board bring-up, RF and antenna integration, microcontrollers/microprocessors, AC-DC, DC-DC and PFC, isolation, creepage and clearance, EMC-aware layout. Interfaces: UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS-485, Modbus, USB, Ethernet, NFC/RFID, cellular/Wi-Fi/BLE. Thermal: Copper pours, thermal vias, TIMs, heatsinks, airflow, power loss estimation, junction temperature calculation, thermal simulation, IR imaging, thermocouples, chamber testing and derating. Testing: Oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum and power analyzers, EMC pre-compliance, HALT/HASS, DVT/PVT, FMEA. Good to Have Experience with ODMs and contract manufacturers. Firmware/Linux bring-up and secure boot familiarity. Experience with US, EU and India certification labs. Thermal failure analysis, and passing temperature-rise tests within one or two attempts.

description:
Role Summary We are looking for a Senior AI Developer / AI Lead with 5-8 years of experience to lead the design and development of enterprise-grade Generative AI and Conversational AI solutions. 
 The role will have a strong hands-on focus on Python, GPT-based LLMs, RAG, AI-powered Knowledge Bases, Conversational AI, AI Evaluation Frameworks, and Microsoft Agent Framework. The candidate will also be responsible for providing technical direction, mentoring team members, and leading AI development initiatives from POC to production.

Strong experience working with LLMs, particularly GPT-based LLMs. Hands-on experience designing and implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions. Experience building AI-powered Knowledge Bases and enterprise knowledge retrieval solutions. Strong experience developing Conversational AI / AI chatbot solutions. Understanding of evaluation parameters such as accuracy, relevance, groundedness/faithfulness, hallucination, and retrieval quality. Ability to design scalable and production-ready GenAI architectures. Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring developers. Ability to review code, define development standards, and guide the team on AI engineering best practices. Experience working directly with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into AI solutions. 
 Good to Have Experience with Azure AI / Microsoft AI ecosystem. Strong understanding of embeddings, chunking, semantic search, reranking, and retrieval optimization. Experience taking GenAI POCs into production. Experience with AI application monitoring, evaluation, and observability. Knowledge of enterprise API and microservices architecture. Experience leading a small AI/GenAI development team. Exposure to multiple LLM providers and models. Leadership Expectations Lead the technical development of GenAI / Conversational AI solutions. Mentor and guide junior and mid-level AI developers. Break down requirements into technical tasks and development plans. Review solution architecture and code quality. Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate AI approaches. Collaborate with business, product, and engineering teams. Ensure AI solutions meet expected quality, performance, security, and scalability standards. 
 Not Required Traditional Machine Learning experience is not mandatory. ML model training/development is not the focus of this role. LangGraph experience is not required .

title: Sr Civil Executive Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Civil Executive Engineer with proven expertise in high-rise residential tower construction to lead execution, quality assurance, and material reconciliation for our premium development projects. The ideal candidate will have successfully completed at least one high-rise residential tower from foundation to handover and demonstrated mastery of complex structural execution in vertical construction. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Project Execution 
 Lead on-site civil engineering activities for high-rise residential tower construction, ensuring all structural works are executed according to approved drawings, specifications, and project timelines. Coordinate closely with structural consultants, contractors, and internal teams to maintain construction momentum while adhering to design intent. Oversee critical construction stages including foundation works, core wall construction, slab pours, fa ade integration, and structural completion. Implement effective construction methodologies and sequencing strategies optimized for high-rise vertical construction. 
 
 Quality Management 
 Establish and maintain rigorous quality control protocols across all civil engineering activities, conducting regular inspections at critical hold points and ensuring compliance with international building codes and local regulatory requirements. Review and approve method statements, inspection and test plans (ITPs), and quality control documentation. Identify non-conformances early, implement corrective actions, and maintain comprehensive quality records. Ensure concrete strength testing, rebar inspection, formwork verification, and structural tolerance checks meet specified standards throughout tower construction. 
 
 Material Reconciliation 
 Manage comprehensive reconciliation of client-issued materials including cement, steel reinforcement, aggregates, admixtures, and other civil construction materials. Track material consumption against approved BOQs, identify variances, and provide detailed analysis of material utilization efficiency. Coordinate with procurement, site stores, and accounts teams to maintain accurate material accounting. Prepare monthly material reconciliation reports highlighting consumption patterns, wastage analysis, and recommendations for optimization. Ensure proper documentation of material receipts, consumption records, and site storage management. 
 
 Coordination and Reporting 
 Serve as the primary technical interface between the project team, main contractor, subcontractors, and consulting engineers for all civil engineering matters. Conduct regular progress meetings, prepare detailed weekly and monthly progress reports, and communicate technical issues requiring resolution. Coordinate civil works with MEP installations, architectural finishes, and external fa ade contractors to ensure seamless integration. Escalate critical technical or schedule issues with proposed solutions to senior management. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited institution. Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in high-rise construction with at least 5 years in senior execution roles. Mandatory requirement: successful completion of at least one high-rise residential tower (minimum 40 floors) from foundation to handover as a key member of the engineering team. Professional engineering license or chartered engineer status preferred. 
 
 Technical Competencies 
 Advanced knowledge of concrete technology, reinforcement detailing, and structural tolerances for high-rise construction. Familiarity with construction management software, CAD tools, and project planning applications. Understanding of surveying principles and ability to verify construction accuracy using modern surveying equipment. Knowledge of safety regulations and best practices for high-rise construction sites. Ability to conduct structural inspections and assessments during various construction phases. 
 
 Location 
 Mumbai, MH

JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Technical Growth Officer 
 Position Overview 
The Technical Growth Officer will be responsible for generating business through technical sales, site visits, customer development, product demonstrations, technical support, and project lead generation .
The role combines technical knowledge with business development and requires the employee to understand customer/site requirements, recommend suitable products and systems, coordinate with internal technical teams, and support the conversion of enquiries into orders.
The Technical Growth Officer will primarily work in the field and develop relationships with customers, contractors, applicators, architects, consultants, builders, developers, industries, and project teams .

 1. Position Details 
 ParticularDetailsDesignation Technical Growth Officer Department Technical Growth / Business Development Reporting To Senior Technical Growth Officer / Project Growth Manager Experience 15 Years Location Assigned Territory Job Type Full-Time Travel Regular field/site travel Industry Preference Waterproofing / Industrial Coatings / Epoxy Flooring / PU Flooring / Construction Chemicals / Technical Sales
 2. Primary Objective 
To generate qualified technical business opportunities, understand customer requirements, provide suitable technical solutions, and support the sales team in converting opportunities into profitable orders.
 Core Responsibility 
 Lead Generation Customer Visit Site Inspection Requirement Understanding Product Recommendation Technical Presentation Quotation Support Follow-Up Order Conversion 

 3. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Technical Business Development 
 Generate new leads through field visits and technical networking. Identify customers requiring waterproofing, flooring, coatings, and construction chemical solutions. Understand customer problems and recommend suitable solutions. Support the sales team with technical inputs. Develop new customers within the assigned territory. Generate project and industrial leads. Identify opportunities for repeat and additional business. Maintain a continuous pipeline of technical opportunities. 
 4. Lead Generation 
Generate leads through:
 Direct market visits Industrial visits Construction sites Contractors Applicators Architects Consultants Builders and developers Existing customers References Dealers/distributors Exhibitions Website enquiries IndiaMART/B2B portals Digital marketing leads All qualified leads must be entered into the company's CRM/system.

 5. Site Visit & Requirement Assessment 
 Visit customer/project sites. Understand site conditions and customer requirements. Identify waterproofing, flooring, coating, leakage, corrosion, insulation, or construction chemical requirements. Take site measurements and photographs where required. Collect technical information. Identify application challenges. Discuss initial technical solutions with the customer. Prepare site visit reports. Coordinate with Senior Technical/Technical Team for complex requirements. 
 6. Product & System Knowledge 
The Technical Growth Officer should develop working knowledge of company products and systems such as:
 Waterproofing 
 PU waterproofing Cementitious waterproofing Crystalline waterproofing Waterproofing membranes Terrace waterproofing Basement waterproofing Joint and crack treatment Flooring 
 Epoxy flooring PU flooring Self-leveling flooring Heavy-duty industrial flooring Anti-skid flooring Protective Coatings 
 Anti-corrosion coatings Industrial protective coatings Heat-insulation coatings Fire-retardant coatings Electrical insulation coatings Construction Chemicals 
 Tile adhesives Epoxy grouts Sealants Repair products Bonding agents Surface treatment products The employee must understand where, why, and how each product/system is used.

 7. Technical Product Presentation 
 Explain product features and applications to customers. Conduct basic technical presentations. Explain product benefits and application procedures. Provide technical datasheets and product information. Conduct product demonstrations when required. Coordinate sample and trial applications. Explain the difference between company systems and competitor solutions. Support product awareness activities. 
 8. Consultant & Architect Visits 
 Visit architects and consultants regularly. Introduce company products and systems. Explain technical applications. Provide product literature and technical documents. Identify specification opportunities. Understand upcoming projects. Develop long-term technical relationships. Maintain consultant visit records. 
 9. Contractor & Applicator Development 
 Identify active contractors and applicators. Develop relationships with them. Understand their project requirements. Introduce suitable products and systems. Coordinate product demonstrations and training. Generate leads through contractor networks. Support contractors during initial product application. Maintain contractor database. 
 10. Customer Handling 
 Conduct regular customer meetings. Understand customer technical and commercial requirements. Provide initial technical guidance. Coordinate with senior technical personnel where required. Maintain professional communication. Follow up after site visits and technical discussions. Collect customer feedback. Identify additional business opportunities. 
 11. Technical Coordination 
Coordinate with:
 Customer Sales Technical Team R&D Estimation Project Team 
Responsibilities include:
 Sharing site information. Sharing customer requirements. Coordinating site inspections. Arranging samples. Coordinating product trials. Supporting technical approvals. Providing technical inputs for quotations. Supporting project handover. Escalating technical issues. 
 12. Quotation Support 
 Understand basic project requirements and BOQ. Provide technical information to the estimation/commercial team. Support preparation of quotations. Ensure the correct product/system is quoted. Follow up on quotations. Coordinate quotation revisions. Inform senior team members about customer feedback and competitor pricing. Support the sales team during negotiations. 
 13. Lead Follow-Up & Conversion 
The employee must maintain strict follow-up on every qualified opportunity.
 Follow-up process: 
 Lead 

 Qualification 

 Customer Meeting 

 Site Visit 

 Technical Requirement 

 Product Recommendation 

 Sample/Trial 

 Quotation 

 Follow-Up 

 Order 
Every opportunity must have a defined next action and expected timeline .

 14. Business Growth Responsibilities 
The Technical Growth Officer is not only a technical support role.
The employee is expected to:
 Generate new business leads. Develop new customers. Generate project enquiries. Support technical approvals. Develop consultants and contractors. Generate product trials. Convert enquiries into orders. Support achievement of sales targets. Generate repeat business. Cross-sell and up-sell suitable products. 
 15. Project Support 
 Identify project opportunities. Collect project information. Coordinate with project sales teams. Support site inspections. Provide technical inputs. Support product trials. Assist in technical meetings. Support project handover after order confirmation. Assist project teams in resolving initial technical queries. 
 16. Customer Complaint Support 
 Understand customer complaints related to product/application. Visit the site when required. Collect photographs and technical information. Report the issue to the senior technical team. Coordinate corrective action. Follow up until resolution. Maintain complaint records. Communicate professionally with customers. 
 17. Daily Field Activity 
The employee is expected to maintain productive field activity including:
 Customer visits Site visits Contractor meetings Consultant meetings Architect meetings New project identification Lead generation Technical presentations Product demonstrations Product trials Quotation follow-ups Business follow-ups Activity quality, lead quality, conversion, and revenue contribution will be evaluatednot only the number of visits. 

 18. CRM & Reporting 
 100% CRM/reporting discipline is mandatory. 
The employee must update:
 New leads Customer information Project details Site visits Technical requirements Product recommendations Samples Trials Quotations Follow-ups Expected order date Expected order value Competitor information Lost opportunity reasons Order status Complaint status Daily Report

title: Assistant Manager/Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform)
description:
Job Description: Assistant Manager/Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform) 
 Function: Supply Chain / Procurement - GBS Position location: Mumbai/Navi Mumbai
 
 Purpose of the Job The Assistant Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform) coordinates day-to-day Food Platform Administration activities and ensures accurate, timely and compliant execution of defined system transactions supporting the Australian Food Platform.
The role executes and coordinates master data administration, purchase order generation, system administration, documentation and reporting within Microsoft Dynamics AX and future Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. It ensures activities are completed in accordance with approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
The position supports operational coordination between GBS Administration and the Australian Food Platform. It does not make operational, culinary, commercial or client decisions. Any activity outside documented procedures must be escalated to the Manager and the Australian Food Platform for direction.
 
 
 Context and Main Issues - The GBS Food Platform Administration team provides structured transactional support to the Australian Food Platform through approved systems and documented procedures. Accuracy of master data, ordering outputs and system transactions is essential to reliable purchasing, inventory planning and Food Platform operations. The role operates in a highly controlled environment where compliance with SOPs, work instructions, SLAs, quality checks and audit requirements is mandatory. The jobholder must coordinate assigned transactional activities, maintain service performance and support effective communication between GBS Administration and Australia. Operational, culinary, commercial and client decisions remain with the Australian Food Platform; exceptions or unclear instructions must be escalated promptly. The role is expected to support standardization, process improvement, system changes and automation while preserving governance, data integrity and documented approval controls. 
 
 Key Responsibilities & Assignments -Service Delivery Coordination 
 Coordinate assigned Food Platform Administration activities to achieve agreed quality, productivity and SLA targets. Monitor daily work queues, priorities and completion status; provide first-level troubleshooting and escalate unresolved issues to the Manager. Work effectively with Australian stakeholders and the Manager to resolve operational issues and implement approved changes. 
 Purchase Order Generation 
 Oversee preparation of purchase requisition requests, future costing orders, recalculation orders and defrost orders in line with approved SOPs. Ensure purchase order files are exported, renamed and retained in accordance with naming conventions and audit requirements. Ensure order templates are created only when instructed, outputs are validated before release, and system errors are escalated immediately. 
 Master Data Administration 
 Ensure accurate creation and maintenance of approved ING and REC master data, including mandatory fields, nutritional information, preparation yields, cooking yields and REC attributes. Oversee approved ING-to-IT linking, item relationship validation and unit conversion creation and maintenance. Maintain version control and system accuracy. No master data change may be made without documented approval from the Australian Food Platform. 
 Data Quality Assurance 
 Apply documented quality checks, validate mandatory fields and complete required validation checklists. Identify and correct data-entry errors, maintain data integrity and audit history, and escalate missing, conflicting or inconsistent information. 
 System Administration Support 
 Oversee routine administration of Food Platform systems, including active trade agreement records, approved system updates and scheduled tasks. Maintain system documentation, follow release procedures and escalate technical issues through the approved support channels. 
 Documentation Management 
 Maintain controlled templates, electronic filing structures and document version control. Archive superseded documents and ensure records comply with approved document-control procedures. 
 Reporting 
 Prepare and distribute approved operational reports to nominated stakeholders within agreed timelines. Validate report completeness and accuracy, and escalate anomalies identified during reporting. 
 Process Compliance & Risk Control 
 Ensure all activities follow approved SOPs, work instructions, quality-management requirements and service levels. Record exceptions, maintain evidence of completed controls and escalate activities that fall outside documented procedures. 
 Continuous Improvement 
 Identify repetitive administrative issues and recommend improvements to documented procedures. Participate in process reviews and User Acceptance Testing, and support implementation of approved process, system and automation improvements. 
 
 Accountabilities -Service Delivery Excellence: 
 Consistent achievement of agreed SLAs, quality, productivity and stakeholder service expectations. 
 Master Data Accuracy & Integrity: 
 Accurate, current and controlled Food Platform master data supported by documented approvals and complete audit history. 
 Order Output Reliability: 
 Timely and accurate generation and validation of purchase order outputs with prompt escalation of errors and exceptions. 
 Process Compliance & Risk Management: 
 Full adherence to approved procedures, quality controls, document-control requirements and escalation protocols. 
 Operational Capability: 
 Reliable execution of assigned activities, effective workload coordination and continued development of role-specific operational capability. 
 Stakeholder Partnership: 
 Professional and transparent coordination with Australian Food Platform stakeholders, supported by disciplined follow-through and clear escalation. 
 Continuous Improvement: 
 Practical improvements that strengthen efficiency, standardisation, control and user experience without compromising governance. 
 
 Experience & Qualifications -Qualifications 
 Graduate in any discipline. A postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations or Business Administration is advantageous. 
 Experience - Essential 
 Demonstrated experience in transactional administration, supply operations, procurement operations or master data activities. Experience working within structured administrative processes and managing delivery against defined procedures, quality measures and service levels. Experience maintaining electronic master data and working within enterprise business systems. Experience using Microsoft Excel for data validation, analysis and operational reporting. Experience coordinating stakeholders, escalations, work priorities and service delivery. 
 Experience - Desirable 
 Experience using Microsoft Dynamics AX or another ERP platform. Experience supporting purchasing, inventory, food platform, hospitality or supply operations processes. Experience working within Shared Services, Global Business Services or a multinational environment. Exposure to process improvement, system testing, transition or change-management initiatives. 
 Technical / Hard Skills 
 Working knowledge of master data administration, purchase order processing, data-quality controls and audit requirements. Ability to interpret and consistently apply SOPs, work instructions, approval matrices and service-level requirements. Competence in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Teams, Word and SharePoint. Strong reporting, documentation, data-validation and issue-management capability. Ability to identify exceptions, assess operational impact and escalate through the appropriate governance channel. 
 Behavioral / Soft Skills 
 Strong coordination, collaboration and peer-support capability. Excellent communication, stakeholder-management and interpersonal skills. Confident and professional engagement with country and overseas stakeholders. High ownership, attention to detail and accountability for service quality and data accuracy. Ability to work independently within defined procedures, manage competing priorities and escalate ambiguity appropriately. Structured thinking, sound problem-solving ability and a continuous-improvement mindset. Collaborative, culturally sensitive and constructive approach, including the ability to challenge existing ways of working professionally. Strong time management and the ability to sustain accuracy across repetitive, high-volume transactional work.

title: Lead Engineer Integrated Smart Pole Solutions
description:
JOB PURPOSE : Smart pole development Own the end-to-end architecture, integration, development and validation of an integrated Smart Pole solution combining smart lighting, video surveillance, environmental sensing, EV charging and digital LED display capabilities. Deliver a secure, interoperable, remotely managed solution by integrating field devices, embedded firmware, communication protocols and software platforms into a scalable, reliable product for smart cities, infrastructure and commercial applications. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Define end-to-end system architecture for an integrated Smart Pole, covering smart LED lighting, CCTV/IP cameras, environmental sensors (air quality, temperature, humidity, noise and other applicable parameters), EV chargers, digital LED display/signage and the central connected management platform. Translate business, customer and project requirements into system specifications, interface-control documents, block diagrams, integration plans, acceptance criteria and product requirements. Lead hardware, embedded firmware, device, network and application integration across heterogeneous vendors and technologies; manage interface dependencies and resolve system-level issues. Integrate communication and application protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, Modbus, TCP/IP, ONVIF, RTSP, BLE, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, LoRaWAN, cellular and other relevant protocols as applicable to selected devices. Define and integrate device onboarding, provisioning, configuration, remote monitoring, diagnostics, alarms, OTA firmware/software updates, data logging, dashboards and fleet/device lifecycle management. Lead firmware and software integration with cloud/edge platforms, mobile/web applications, analytics, video management systems, lighting controls, EV charging management systems and third-party enterprise/city platforms. Establish cybersecurity-by-design for devices and platforms, including secure boot, signed firmware, identity and certificate management, authentication/authorization, encryption, key management, network segmentation, vulnerability management and secure update mechanisms. Ensure interoperability, scalability, availability and performance across multi-vendor devices; define fallback modes, offline behaviour, time synchronisation, data integrity and fault recovery. Plan and execute integration testing, system verification, field trials, reliability testing, cybersecurity testing and user acceptance; manage defects through root-cause analysis and closure. Coordinate with electronics, mechanical, lighting, firmware, software, cloud, cybersecurity, EV charging, camera, sensor, display, manufacturing, quality, sourcing and service teams, as well as external technology partners. Evaluate vendors and technical solutions; review datasheets, SDKs, APIs, protocol specifications, firmware release notes and compliance evidence. Drive proof-of-concepts and technical due diligence. Prepare and maintain architecture documents, interface specifications, BOM inputs, test plans, deployment guides, service procedures and technical documentation. Support design-for-manufacturing, installation and commissioning, remote serviceability, lifecycle management, cost optimisation and product roadmap planning. Drive project execution, risks, milestones and technical reviews; mentor engineers and ensure delivery against agreed quality, cost, performance and schedule targets. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS 
 Bachelors degree in Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication / Electrical / Instrumentation / Computer Engineering or a related discipline. Master’s degree or relevant specialisation in embedded systems, IoT, networking, cybersecurity or systems engineering is an advantage. WORK EXPERIENCE 
 10–12 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, system integration, connected devices or industrial/urban technology solutions. Demonstrated ownership of at least one complex, multi-device solution from architecture and proof-of-concept through integration, validation and deployment. Hands-on experience integrating hardware, firmware, communication protocols, APIs and cloud/edge software across multiple vendors. CERTIFICATIONS 
 Relevant certifications in IoT, embedded systems, networking, cloud architecture or cyber-security are desirable (e.g., cloud/IoT platform, networking or security certifications). PREFERRED/ ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT 
 Strong understanding of embedded Linux/RTOS, device drivers, firmware lifecycle, OTA updates, APIs, SDKs, databases and cloud/edge architectures. Practical exposure to smart lighting controls, IP video surveillance, environmental sensors, EV charging systems and digital signage is highly desirable. Experience with MQTT brokers, REST APIs, device management platforms, Linux tools, packet/protocol analysis and integration/debugging tools. Knowledge of device and platform security, secure coding practices, threat modelling, vulnerability handling and relevant standards such as IEC 62443 is an advantage. Ability to read schematics, interface diagrams, protocol documents and firmware/software logs; strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills. Experience in smart city, street lighting, infrastructure, industrial IoT or public-space deployments is preferred. Willingness to support field integration, commissioning and troubleshooting at customer/vendor locations as required. REPORTEES 
 May guide and coordinate integration engineers / cross-functional project resources; formal direct reportees to be defined based on project structure. INTERNAL / EXTERNAL INTERFACE 
 Internal: R&D – Electronics, Firmware, Software, IoT/Cloud, Lighting, Mechanical, Cybersecurity, Quality, Testing & Validation, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Product Management, Sales/Projects and Service. External: Camera, sensor, EV charger, LED display and lighting suppliers; system integrators; cloud/platform partners; telecom/network providers; cybersecurity/testing agencies; customers, EPCs and smart-city/municipal stakeholders. FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES 
 System architecture and systems engineering IoT and multi-protocol integration / API integration Embedded firmware and device lifecycle management Cloud/edge platform and application integration Device, network and platform cybersecurity Integration planning, verification, validation and field commissioning Technical documentation, vendor evaluation and root-cause analysis Project execution, risk management and cross-functional coordination BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES 
 Think Beyond Put Customers first Collaborate to Win Develop Talent Be the Best Be Agile

title: Senior Lead Production Engineer
description:
Main Purpose:- 
 The Senior Lead Production Engineer will drive production optimization and performance enhancement across conventional oil & gas fields and CBM assets. The role is responsible for maximizing hydrocarbon recovery through integrated production engineering, well performance analysis, network modelling, artificial lift optimization, flow assurance, and field operations support. The incumbent will work closely with operations, subsurface, drilling and completions teams to identify production opportunities, resolve technical bottlenecks, manage production risks, and develop sustainable strategies for long-term asset performance while ensuring compliance with Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) standards. 
 Job Accountabilities 1. Production Performance Analysis & Optimization Monitor and analyse well, field and network production performance against production potential, identifying production losses, deferrals and improvement opportunities. Conduct well inflow and outflow analysis, nodal analysis and integrated production system modelling to optimize well and network performance. Build and maintain well and network models using industry-standard simulation tools such as OLGA, PIPESIM, PROSPER and GAP. Identify and implement opportunities to improve well productivity, production rates, recovery and overall network efficiency. Analyse production constraints and recommend remedial actions to sustain and enhance field performance. Support the development of short-, medium- and long-term production optimization strategies aligned with asset and business objectives. 2. Well, Production Operations & Artificial Lift Support Provide hands-on technical expertise in production operations, well completions,well interventions and sand control. Evaluate,design and optimize the performance of artificial lift systems, including PCP, SRP and Gas Lift, considering well and field operating constraints. Support the development and execution of well intervention and artificial lift optimization strategies to sustain and enhance production. Troubleshoot production and operational challenges in collaboration with field operations and technical teams. Provide technical support and recommendations on basic surface processing facilities and production systems. Drive the adoption of innovative technologies and best practices to improve production efficiency and operational reliability. 3. Flow Assurance & Production Risk Management Develop and implement effective flow assurance strategies to identify, prevent and mitigate production risks. Address operational challenges related to hydrate formation, sand production, wax deposition and scale management to minimize production losses and downtime. Apply integrated well and network analysis to identify and resolve flow-related bottlenecks. Provide support on subsea flow assurance requirements, where applicable. Collaborate with surface, subsurface and operations teams to develop integrated solutions for complex production and flow assurance challenges. 4. Technical Assurance & Compliance Provide independent technical review and assurance for production optimization plans, production management proposals and key engineering decisions. Conduct technical risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation measures are incorporated into production strategies and operations. Ensure compliance with company standards, applicable regulations and international oil & gas industry practices. Promote and uphold the highest standards of Health, Safety and Environment (HSE)across all production-related activities. 5. Collaboration & Technical Leadership Partner with multidisciplinary and site-based teams to identify and implement production optimization initiatives. Lead and mentor production engineers, strengthening technical capability and fostering a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement. Act as a key technical interface between operations, subsurface, drilling,completions and other stakeholders. Support knowledge sharing, technical problem-solving and the implementation of best practices across assets. Functional Competencies Strong hands-on experience in production operations, production engineering,well completions and well interventions. Expertise in well performance analysis, including inflow and outflow analysis, nodal analysis and production optimization. Strong experience in well and network modelling using tools such as OLGA,PIPESIM, PROSPER, GAP or equivalent simulation software. Experience in the design, analysis and optimization of artificial lift systems, including PCP, SRP and Gas Lift. Strong knowledge of sand control and sand production management. Good understanding of basic surface processing facilities and production systems. Expertise in flow assurance, including hydrate, wax, scale and sand management. Experience in subsea flow assurance will be an added advantage. Strong understanding of production optimization methodologies, integrated asset modelling and production network management. Sound knowledge of HSE regulations, technical assurance processes and upstream oil & gas industry best practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management and technical leadership skills. 
 Education B.E./B.Tech in Petroleum or Chemical Engineering. 
 Experience Minimum 14 years of relevant experience in the upstream oil & gas industry. Demonstrated expertise in production engineering, field operations, production optimization, well performance management and integrated production systems.

title: Export Logistic || Chemical Manufacturing || Santacruz (East) - Mumbai
description:
We are looking for an experienced export logistics professional to handle shipments from our EOU and SEZ manufacturing units. A large share of these shipments are hazardous chemicals. The person will manage day-to-day exports, work closely with internal teams and logistics partners, and understand how shipment decisions affect safety, compliance and cost. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Export Operations 
 Plan and carry out sea and air export shipments with Sales, Production, Planning, Stores, QA and Customer Service. Arrange freight bookings, containers, transportation and customs clearance. Handle factory stuffing and self-sealing in line with the permission conditions. Track vessel and flight schedules, cut-offs and shipment progress, and inform stakeholders of any changes. Resolve booking issues, delays and documentation problems. 
 Hazardous Cargo (DG) Shipments 
 Handle hazardous chemical exports by sea and air safely and in line with the applicable dangerous goods rules. Read Safety Data Sheets (SDS), especially the UN number, hazard class, packing group and marine pollutant status. Check that packaging is UN-approved and that marking, labelling and placarding are correct. Prepare and check DG declarations and other hazardous cargo documents before submission. Get DG approvals from shipping lines and airlines in advance, and plan around port, terminal, vessel and aircraft restrictions. Check segregation and compatibility when hazardous products are shipped together or with non-hazardous cargo. 
 EOU / SEZ Compliance 
 Handle export procedures for both EOU and SEZ units. Make sure shipments follow the unit's approval conditions and applicable procedures. Coordinate with plant teams, customs brokers and the relevant authorities. Keep up to date with relevant Customs, DGFT, SEZ and GST changes, and flag anything that affects operations. 
 Documentation and Export Incentives 
 Review invoices, packing lists, shipping bill checklists and BL/AWB drafts. Make sure quantities, values, HS codes, consignee details, Incoterms and SDS details match across all documents. Ensure correct declarations on export documents, including the scheme (EOU/SEZ), LUT, self-sealing details and export incentives such as RoDTEP. Coordinate Certificates of Origin, insurance and other shipment requirements. Follow up for final shipping documents and proof-of-export records. 
 GST and Incoterms 
 Apply basic GST knowledge to export transactions and work with Finance on invoicing, e-way bills and refund records. Use Incoterms to decide responsibility for freight, insurance, delivery and customs. Check customer terms against freight quotations and shipping instructions before confirming arrangements. 
 Freight Costs and Accounting 
 Get and compare freight quotations, including DG surcharges, and support negotiations. Check vendor invoices against agreed rates, Incoterms and the services actually provided. Understand debit and credit entries, vendor balances, advances and debit/credit notes. Find incorrect or duplicate charges and follow up on pending credits. Work with Finance on invoice processing, vendor reconciliation and payment follow-up. Avoid unnecessary detention, demurrage and storage charges. Reporting 
 Prepare SAP-based sales, pending-order and freight-cost reports. Maintain shipment trackers and pending-action lists. Keep shipment records ready for audits, reconciliations and management reviews. Suggest practical improvements to reduce delays and errors.

title: Brand Visualiser (Video Editing / Design / Motion)
description:
Design, Motion & Visual Communication Experience: 6-7+ Years Function: Brand / Marketing / Creative Company: DTDC Express Ltd. 
 About the Role 
 DTDC is looking for a Senior Brand Visualiser who can translate brand and communication objectives into compelling visual ideas and execute them across multiple formats. This is not a traditional graphic design or video-editing role. We are looking for a visual thinker and storyteller who understands how to build a visual narrative, develop a creative direction and communicate an idea through design, imagery, typography, motion and video. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable conceptualising a campaign, creating its visual language, designing the static assets and bringing the idea to life through motion and video. The role also requires strong hands-on knowledge of Generative AI and AI-powered creative workflows, including image generation, video generation, voice, avatars and prompt engineering. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Visualisation & Creative Conceptualisation Develop creative concepts and visual directions based on brand, marketing and communication objectives. Translate a brief or business problem into a strong visual idea or creative concept. Develop Key Visuals (KVs), campaign territories, moodboards, storyboards and visual narratives. Decide how an idea should be communicated visually across different platforms and formats. Think beyond individual creatives and build connected visual systems for campaigns. Develop visual storytelling through composition, typography, imagery, colour, illustration, motion and sequencing. Present and communicate creative concepts clearly to internal stakeholders and explain the thinking behind the visual direction. Ensure that creative ideas are both conceptually strong and relevant to the DTDC brand. Brand & Graphic Design Design high-quality creative assets across digital, social, print, internal communication and marketing platforms. Develop campaign KVs, social media creatives, digital banners, mailers, presentations, OOH creatives, internal communication and other brand collaterals. Maintain strong visual consistency and adherence to DTDC's brand identity. Have a strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, hierarchy, composition and visual communication. Adapt a single creative idea into multiple formats while retaining its core visual identity. Create designs that are not only aesthetically strong but also communicate the intended message clearly and quickly. 
 Video & Motion 
 Conceptualise and create videos, reels, motion graphics and short-form brand content. Translate static campaign ideas into motion and video narratives. Create storyboards, shot concepts and visual sequences before production. Edit and produce videos using professional video-editing and motion-graphics tools. Understand pacing, transitions, visual rhythm, sound and storytelling. Collaborate with internal teams, production partners, photographers, videographers and other creative stakeholders where required. 
 AI & Generative Creative 
 Use AI as an integral part of the creative process to improve ideation, experimentation, production and visual storytelling. Hands-on experience with tools such as: ChatGPT: ideation, creative development, research and prompt engineering Nano Banana: AI image generation and image manipulation Seedream: AI image generation Seedance: AI video generation and animation Runway: AI video generation and creative production Adobe Firefly: generative design and image creation ElevenLabs: AI voice generation and sound HeyGen: AI avatars and video generation Other emerging AI image, video, audio and creative tools The candidate should be able to evaluate different AI tools and determine which tool and workflow is appropriate for a particular creative requirement. 
 Software & Technical Skills Design Adobe Photoshop Adobe Illustrator Adobe InDesign Video Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects DaVinci Resolve AI / Creative Technology ChatGPT Nano Banana Seedream Seedance Runway Adobe Firefly ElevenLabs HeyGen Other emerging Generative AI platforms Knowledge of Blender / 3D would be an added advantage.

title: Senior Engineer, Digital Collaboration & Messaging (SharePoint)
description:
Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint) The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint) is a senior technical practitioner responsible specifically for the engineering, administration, governance, reliability, migration, and continuous improvement of the firm's enterprise SharePoint Online environment. This role serves as the technical subject matter expert for SharePoint within the Messaging and Productivity Platforms function. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift. Key Job Responsibilities include: The engineer will own the technical administration and engineering of SharePoint Online and play a significant role in SharePoint migrations, tenant consolidations, mergers and acquisitions, content remediation, lifecycle management, governance, and automation. SharePoint Online Administration & Engineering Engineer, administer, and continuously improve the enterprise SharePoint Online environment. Maintain tenant-level SharePoint configurations and administrative controls. Establish and maintain standards for site architecture, provisioning, permissions, ownership, sharing, and lifecycle management. Manage and monitor SharePoint storage, site collections, access, configuration, and platform health. Develop scalable technical solutions for SharePoint administration and management. Evaluate SharePoint Online product changes and assess their potential impact on the enterprise environment. Plan, test, and implement SharePoint platform changes in a controlled and supportable manner. Identify and remediate stale, abandoned, redundant, orphaned, or improperly configured SharePoint sites. Develop automation using PowerShell, PnP PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, and other appropriate technologies. Reduce manual SharePoint administration through repeatable engineering and automation. SharePoint Migration Engineering; Plan and execute enterprise SharePoint Online migrations. Support SharePoint migrations associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, tenant consolidations, and organizational transformation. Perform technical discovery and assessment of source SharePoint environments. Analyze sites, content, permissions, metadata, links, customizations, dependencies, and other migration considerations. Determine migration readiness and identify technical risks, remediation requirements, and dependencies. Develop migration strategies, technical migration plans, sequencing, migration waves, validation procedures, and rollback approaches. Configure and operate enterprise SharePoint migration technologies. Develop scripts and automation to improve migration discovery, preparation, execution, validation, and reporting. Troubleshoot complex migration failures and develop appropriate remediation strategies. Perform pre- and post-migration validation of content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality. Identify obsolete, redundant, unsupported, or unnecessary content and determine appropriate remediation rather than automatically carrying technical debt into the destination environment. Develop repeatable migration processes and standards that can be reused for future migration initiatives. Transition migrated environments into established SharePoint governance and lifecycle-management processes. SharePoint Governance & Lifecycle Management Establish and maintain enterprise SharePoint governance standards. Define and maintain standards for site provisioning, ownership, permissions, external sharing, and lifecycle. Establish processes for identifying and managing inactive, abandoned, and orphaned sites. Support site expiration, archival, retention, and decommissioning processes. Maintain appropriate controls for external and guest sharing. Partner with Information Security on SharePoint security and data-protection requirements. Partner with Identity & Access Management on SharePoint authentication, access, guest identity, and related access-management requirements. Improve visibility into SharePoint ownership, usage, storage, health, and lifecycle. Identify opportunities to reduce SharePoint technical debt and platform sprawl. Advanced SharePoint Troubleshooting Serve as an advanced engineering escalation point for complex SharePoint Online issues. Troubleshoot complex permissions, authentication, access, sharing, configuration, content, and migration problems. Investigate issues that cannot be effectively resolved through established frontline or second-level support processes. Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions where possible. Identify patterns across escalated incidents that indicate broader platform or governance problems. Engage Microsoft and SharePoint technology vendors when vendor-level escalation is required. Document solutions and transfer repeatable troubleshooting knowledge to appropriate support teams. Required Experience & Qualifications 5+ years of experience administering and engineering enterprise SharePoint environments. Deep hands-on experience with SharePoint Online in a medium-to-large enterprise environment. Strong experience with enterprise SharePoint administration, configuration, governance, and lifecycle management. Demonstrated experience planning and executing large-scale SharePoint migrations. Experience with SharePoint Online tenant-to-tenant migrations or similar complex enterprise migration initiatives. Strong understanding of SharePoint architecture, sites, permissions, sharing, metadata, storage, and content structures. Experience performing technical discovery and migration-readiness assessments. Experience troubleshooting complex SharePoint Online platform and migration issues. Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex technical problems. Experience working with enterprise security, compliance, retention, and data-governance requirements. Experience working within enterprise Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes. Strong technical documentation and communication skills. Ability to independently drive complex technical work across multiple technical and business teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with enterprise SharePoint migration platforms such as ShareGate or equivalent technologies. Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or tenant consolidations involving SharePoint. Experience migrating SharePoint Server or other legacy SharePoint environments to SharePoint Online. Experience with Microsoft Purview capabilities relevant to SharePoint, including retention, information protection, and eDiscovery. Implement quality control measures and validate testing documentation. Monitor monthly Factory Routine Test (FRT) and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) data and publish key performance indicators (KPIs). Coordinate with customers during witness testing and Factory Acceptance Tests. Ensure timely completion of testing activities and resolution of technical issues.

 6. Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) Ensure EHS compliance across shop-floor testing activities. Maintain records of safety training for testing engineers and technicians. Maintain safety and compliance documentation for service providers. Ensure adherence to Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA), Permit to Work (PTW), Toolbox Talks (TBT), and Last-Minute Risk Assessment (LMRA) processes. Knowledge of IEC 62271, IEEE C37 series, and other relevant standards. Understanding of protection relay systems and switchgear control schemes. Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Effective communication and stakeholder management. Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines under pressure. Safety Requirements Knowledge of electrical safety procedures and arc-flash safety protocols. Advanced electrical safety certification preferred. First aid and emergency response training preferred. schedules and tracking data.

plans.

description:
Job Description: Fulfilment Executive(Dispatch Executive B2B Order SALES) 
 Department: B2B Sales 
 Reporting To: B2B Fulfilment Head 
 Location: Mumbai(Govandi) 
 Night shift Only 
 
 Role Purpose The Fulfilment Executive is responsible for ensuring that every B2B order is dispatched accurately, on time, in full, and in accordance with the company's quality standards. This is a highly execution-oriented role that requires the incumbent to be stationed at the dispatch area, performing physical order verification, quality checks, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless order fulfilment. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day execution of all B2B order fulfilment activities from the dispatch area. Physically verify every B2B order prior to dispatch to ensure: Correct product and quantity Proper packaging Compliance with quality standards Conduct quality control (QC) checks within the CRM system and promptly highlight any product or fulfilment discrepancies. Coordinate the end-to-end fulfilment process, from order confirmation through successful dispatch and delivery. Collaborate closely with Production, Supply Chain, Operations, and Sales teams to ensure timely order execution. Monitor order status proactively and resolve fulfilment bottlenecks to avoid delays. Escalate inventory shortages, quality concerns, dispatch delays, or operational issues to the relevant stakeholders. Ensure accurate documentation, invoicing, and maintenance of order records. Handle fulfilment-related customer queries and coordinate timely resolution with internal teams. Maintain daily fulfilment reports, dispatch trackers, and issue logs. Ensure adherence to fulfilment SOPs and contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance dispatch accuracy and efficiency. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Delivery (OTD): Ensure orders are dispatched and delivered within committed timelines. OTIF (On Time In Full): Ensure complete order fulfilment without shortages, damages, or misses. Order Accuracy & Quality: Dispatch orders with the correct products, quantities, packaging, and quality standards. Dispatch Accuracy: Minimize fulfilment errors and maintain high operational accuracy. Issue Resolution: Timely identification and resolution of fulfilment-related concerns. Qualifications & Experience Graduate (or Undergraduate) in any discipline. 2-4 years of relevant experience in: Order Fulfilment Warehouse Operations Dispatch Operations Supply Chain Customer Service Operations Experience in Food & Beverage, QSR, Retail, FMCG, E-commerce, or Quick Commerce industries is preferred. Prior experience handling high-volume order fulfilment and warehouse/dispatch operations is highly desirable. Strong attention to detail with a hands-on execution mindset. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume operational environment. 
 Preferred Industry Background Candidates from the following industries will be preferred: Quick Service Restaurants (QSR) Food & Beverage FMCG Retail Quick Commerce E-commerce Preference will be given to candidates with experience handling products with limited shelf life and time-sensitive dispatch operations.

title: Medical representative
description:
Job Summary Medical representative incentives calculated from stockist data and paid in days. Pharma companies pay medical representatives on division slabs, headquarter gates and stockist secondary sales that arrive late and get revised. Kennect is pharma incentive compensation software that pulls that data and applies every rule in a dated plan version. Each representative sees the payout before the cycle closes. The problem A pharma incentive cycle starts with stockist secondary sales that arrive weeks after month end and change after returns and expiry adjustments. Divisions run different slabs, headquarters carry gates, and first line managers earn on their teams. In many companies it runs in spreadsheets the field cannot see. Stockist data lands weeks after the month closes Late payouts Secondary sales come from stockist statements and distributor systems in different formats. The incentive team cleans and maps them by hand, so payouts land two to three months after the work. Every division runs its own slabs and gates Spreadsheet sprawl Cardiac, diabetes and acute divisions set different products, slabs and coverage gates. Each one lives in a separate workbook, and one formula change can alter hundreds of payouts without anyone noticing. Representatives cannot see how the payout was reached Trust and attrition A representative sees a final number with no slab, gate or stockist line behind it. Queries pile up after payout, and top performers read the silence as a reason to leave. The payee map Data sources Stockist secondary sales Distributor management system SFA and call reporting ERP primary sales HRMS Territory and HQ master Kennect reads each source, maps every payee to a headquarter and division for the month, and pays from one dated plan version. Plan mechanics Division product slabs Payout rate rises in steps as secondary sales achievement crosses each slab, set separately for every division and focus brand. Kennect holds each division's slab table in a dated plan version and shows the representative the gap to the next slab. Stockist sales attribution Stockist sales are mapped to headquarters and representatives, with returns, expiry and breakage netted out before achievement is calculated. Kennect ingests stockist and distributor files, applies that month's territory mapping and recalculates when a stockist revises a statement. Coverage and call average gates A representative qualifies after meeting doctor coverage, call average or prescriber targets reported through the SFA. Kennect reads SFA call data, applies each gate before the slab payout and shows the payee which gate held the amount. First line manager payout Area and regional managers earn on team achievement, often with a share-of-team rule such as 70% of representatives on target. Kennect rolls results up the month's hierarchy snapshot, so a mid-month transfer credits the right manager. Vacancy and transfer proration Vacant headquarters, new joiners and mid-cycle transfers change who is paid on which target, and for how many days. Kennect prorates targets and payouts by days in role and records each change against the hierarchy version used. Quarterly true-up and recovery Monthly advances are reconciled against quarterly or annual achievement, and excess payouts are recovered from future cycles. Kennect calculates the true-up, posts recoveries to the payee ledger and shows the representative each adjustment line. Launch contests Short contests reward a new launch, a focus SKU or a quarter-end push on top of the standing plan. Kennect runs contests beside the main plan with their own rules, caps and dates, paid in the same cycle. Sources: Kennect discovery calls with Indian pharma and medtech companies; Kennect product documentation. Compliance The Code on Wages, 2019 came into force. Section 2(y) keeps commission out of wages, but excluded pay above half of total remuneration is added back. That changes the base for gratuity and other wage-linked dues when incentives form a large share of pay. Under Section 143(3)(i) of the Companies Act 2013, the auditor reports on internal financial controls, and incentive accruals sit inside that scope. Kennect records each payout against the plan version, the source data and the approver. It also holds every representative's monthly incentive by component, which HR needs for the wage test.

title: Expert Sr Manager, AI Engineering
description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

 Experience: Minimum 10 years

 About the Role Our Germany-based office is looking for an experienced, hands-on professional to manage the technical planning, fabrication and construction of exhibition stands for trade fairs (Messe) in Germany and across Europe. The primary responsibility is to turn existing designs and concepts into high-quality, practical and cost-effective exhibition stands. The candidate will coordinate with designers, workshops, suppliers and European installation teams to ensure that stands are manufactured, transported, assembled and dismantled successfully. 
 Key Responsibilities Translate existing exhibition stand designs into detailed technical and fabrication drawings, production plans and assembly instructions. Manage stand construction, including carpentry, joinery, metal fabrication, CNC cutting, lighting and finishing. Select suitable materials and optimise construction methods, costs and production time. Prepare bills of materials, cost estimates and project budgets. Coordinate fabrication workshops, suppliers, logistics and installation teams. Ensure quality, structural stability, safe installation and compliance with applicable German and European exhibition venue requirements. Supervise on-site stand assembly and dismantling in Germany and other European countries when required. 
 Requirements Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in exhibition stand construction, fabrication or exhibition project execution. Strong practical knowledge of materials, manufacturing processes, CNC machinery and technical drawings. Experience converting designs into finished, ready-to-install exhibition stands. Ability to independently manage projects from technical planning through fabrication to final installation. Good English communication, organisational and cost-management skills. Willingness to travel occasionally to Europe. 
 Experience working with German or European trade fairs and contractors is a strong advantage. Knowledge of AutoCAD, SketchUp and other technical drawing tools is preferred. 
 How to Apply Please submit your CV, photographs or a portfolio of completed exhibition stands, details of at least three projects personally managed, current salary, expected salary and notice period. 
 Important: We are looking for a practical construction and execution specialistnot primarily a graphic designer, 3D visualiser or event coordinator. The ideal candidate knows how to take a design created by someone else and turn it into a professionally built exhibition stand.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Position Overview 
 We are seeking highly motivated fresh graduates or professionals with up to 1 year of experience to join our PDS team in Mumbai as Project Engineers. This exceptional learning opportunities in construction project management, providing exposure to high-profile commercial real estate projects for leading multinational clients. You will work alongside experienced project managers and engineers while developing technical and professional competencies essential for a successful career in project management. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Project Delivery Support: You will support the PDS team in delivering construction and fit-out projects across various asset classes. This includes assisting project engineers and managers with day-to-day project coordination, tracking project milestones, and ensuring deliverables are completed according to established timelines. You will gain comprehensive exposure to JLLs project delivery methodologies and governance frameworks. Site Supervision Quality Monitoring: Regular site visits to active construction sites will form a critical part of your learning experience. You will accompany senior team members to commercial office developments, corporate fit-out projects, and other facilities to observe construction activities, understand site management practices, and learn quality control procedures. Responsibilities include documenting site conditions through photographs, noting work progress, identifying quality issues, and assisting in punch list preparation. Technical Documentation Drawing Management: You will assist in reviewing and managing technical documentation including architectural drawings, MEP layouts, structural plans, and specifications. This involves coordinating drawing revisions, maintaining updated drawing registers, tracking submittal logs, and ensuring document version control. You will learn to identify potential clashes or coordination issues across different engineering disciplines. Meeting Coordination Reporting: Supporting the preparation and distribution of meeting agendas, attending project meetings, recording minutes, and tracking action items will develop your project coordination skills. You will help prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, project presentations, and status dashboards for internal teams and client stakeholders. Contractor Vendor Coordination: You will assist in coordinating with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and material suppliers. This includes tracking contractor deliverables, obtaining competitive quotations, maintaining vendor databases, processing material submittals and approvals, and supporting the procurement process under guidance from senior team members. Budget Schedule Tracking: Learning to monitor project budgets and schedules is essential. You will assist in tracking costs against approved budgets, reviewing contractor payment applications, maintaining cost registers, and helping prepare budget variance reports. For schedule management, you will support updating project schedules, tracking critical path activities, and identifying potential delays. Health, Safety Environment (HSE): Understanding and promoting safety culture is paramount. You will participate in site safety inductions, attend safety meetings, assist in conducting safety inspections, and ensure compliance with JLLs HSE policies. You will learn to identify potential hazards and understand corrective action protocols. Client Interaction Relationship Management: Under supervision, you will gain exposure to client interactions, learning professional communication standards and relationship management practices. This includes attending client meetings, understanding client requirements, and delivering service excellence aligned with JLL PDS standards. Continuous Learning Professional Development: Active participation in JLLs training programs, technical workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions is expected. You will have opportunities to learn industry best practices, emerging technologies in construction, and project management tools and techniques. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education: Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline from a recognized institution. Recent graduates or professionals with up to 1 year of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of construction processes, building systems, and engineering principles Familiarity with reading technical drawings and engineering specifications Basic proficiency in AutoCAD (ability to view and understand drawings) Competency in MS Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Willingness to learn project management software such as MS Project, Primavera, or similar tools Core Competencies: Strong desire to learn and grow within the project management profession Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi (verbal and written) Detail-oriented with good organizational and time management abilities Ability to work collaboratively in team environments Proactive attitude with problem-solving mindset Adaptability and willingness to take on diverse responsibilities Professional demeanor suitable for client-facing interactions Other Requirements: Willingness to conduct frequent site visits across Mumbai and surrounding areas (MMR region) Flexibility to work on-site as required by project demands Ability to work occasionally beyond standard hours to meet project deadlines 
 
 Location 
 Mumbai, MH Scheduled Weekly Hours: 48

description:
Job Description: Linux Support Engineer Python 
 Company: Clover Infotech Job Location: Andheri East, Mumbai
 Experience Required: 3 to 5 Years
 Primary Skills: Linux Administration, Python Scripting 
 About Clover Infotech Clover Infotech is an IT services and consulting company that provides technology solutions, infrastructure management, application services and digital transformation services to enterprise clients. 
 Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Linux Support Engineer with 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Linux administration and working knowledge of Python scripting. The candidate will be responsible for Linux server monitoring, troubleshooting, system administration and automation of routine operational tasks. The role involves supporting IT infrastructure, ensuring system availability, resolving technical incidents and collaborating with relevant teams to maintain smooth operations.

Troubleshoot Linux-related issues and perform root-cause analysis. Manage users, groups, file permissions, processes and system services. Coordinate with application, network, database and infrastructure teams to resolve issues. Maintain technical documentation and follow established operational procedures. Ensure compliance with applicable security policies and service-level agreements.
